environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; long, delicate antennae; amber-brown translucent wings; flat, aerodynamic body.

visual_logic.composition: A side-angle view of a cockroach scurrying along the side of a fallen log. The texture of the 'shingle' bark is highly detailed. In the background, the misty morning light catches a spiderweb covered in dew.
visual_logic.ground: A rich, moist environment of dark red-brown soil and purple clay fragments.
visual_logic.lighting: Soft, cool morning light with high humidity, making the cockroach's back look damp and reflective.
